tested_headless: Harness builds of source_commit, the saves of games 3, 4 and 5 and the turn-241 save of game 6, with S2 off (define 0) and on (250), HARNESS_DEFENCE_DIAG. At the saves: the staged forecast reaches its leader's threshold in 4, 6, 7 and 2 AI cities, and the danger flag switches on in 3, 5, 6 and 2 cities that were not in danger. Ten turns from each save, same seed: game 3 and game 5 identical captures and wars; game 4 three captures off, two on (one run each, an anecdote); game 6: the Sumerian city facing a Persian force at peace (axemen next to it, galleys carrying spearmen and a ram) went from 1 to 4 defenders with S2 on, its forecast from 1000 to 0, and stayed at 1 defender with S2 off. Profile of three turns of game 5: before memoizing, the forecast took 24 % of turn time; with the per-city memo, 1.9 %, and the whole turns took 33.7 s on against 33.9 s off; harness telemetry with and without the memo identical but for turn times
